items.title: Arthur Baron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I did a ... wonderful CD last fall out in California with a gentleman ... named Mark Masters and he wrote a bunch of features for me with his big band

ctx.x: Exactly. You mentioned that you’re practicing, I’m wondering about self motivation. How do you deal with down time? Are you motivated or not motivated?

Well it varies. Sometimes I just have to do the “act as if” or “fake it ‘til you make it” kind of idea. Because like when I have something, you know, to look forward to, like I did a © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

wonderful CD last fall out in California with a gentleman who has an organization called the American Jazz Institute named Mark Masters and he wrote a bunch of features for me with his big band with a lot of plungers and stuff, and high, with the little mute inside the trombone. And I took two months to make sure my chops were up to being able to do take after take every day for like three days. And you know, so that was an existing goal. So now I have to make my own goals. You know sometimes I try to talk myself…
